titleText: €15 million in funds for arts hub to be reallocated after archaeological finds
mainText: From Times of Malta: €15 million in funds for arts hub to be reallocated after archaeological finds. Project completion date in doubt after discovery of what is believed to be largest Punic quarry ever found

titleText: Robert Abela defends Malta’s economic model, says country remains resilient amid European challenges
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Robert Abela defends Malta’s economic model, says country remains resilient amid European challenges. Prime Minister Robert Abela has defended the government's economic model, insisting that Malta continues to perform strongly despite the economic challenges facing countries across Europe.

titleText: Robert Abela defends foreign worker measures, accuses Opposition of double standards
mainText: From MaltaToday: Robert Abela defends foreign worker measures, accuses Opposition of double standards. Measures imposing new financial burdens on non-EU workers are “calibrated and just”, Robert Abela told parliament on Monday evening, rejecting accusations of discrimination and racism.

titleText: Borg questions Abela-Caruana rift over €90,000 population report
mainText: From Times of Malta: Borg questions Abela-Caruana rift over €90,000 population report. Opposition leader asks who is telling the truth as prime minister and finance minister differ on population projections

titleText: Alex Borg accuses Abela and Caruana of failing to understand workers, says they are ‘used to luxury’
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Alex Borg accuses Abela and Caruana of failing to understand workers, says they are ‘used to luxury’. Opposition Leader Alex Borg accused Prime Minister Robert Abela and Finance Minister Clyde Caruana of being out of touch with ordinary workers, arguing that they cannot understand the financial pressures facing Maltese families because they are “used to luxury”.
